articles.title: Landlords seek ‘one off payments’ to beat Renters Rights Act – claim
articles.summary: The claim is made in an online blog
articles.ai_summary:
- Landlords are advocating for "one-off payments" to circumvent the implications of the new Renters Rights Act.

articles.title: Regaining possession already tougher thanks to S21 demise
articles.summary: Section 8 is now the only legal means of evictions for landlords
articles.ai_summary:
- The abolition of Section 21 has made it more challenging for landlords to regain possession of their rental properties.  
- Section 8 is now the sole legal avenue for evictions, increasing complexity and uncertainty for landlords.
